description:
All papers by a researcher, with match quality, position and full author list.

    Name matching is word-based and ranked: exact > reordered (e.g. 'Dong Xu' vs
    'Xu Dong') > contains_words (extra initials/middle names) > partial (substring).
    Each paper appears once; every result carries its author list.

    Args:
        author_name: Researcher name, e.g. 'Yann LeCun', 'lecun'
        limit:       Max papers (default: 20, max: 50)
        match:       'words' (default: exact, reordered, contains_words; falls back to
                     partial only if nothing else matches), 'exact' (exact + reordered),
                     'partial' (also pure substring matches)
name: arxiv_author_papers
